basis: Predeclared primary strict-dominance gate: learned quality improved slightly but cumulative context increased from 2183.62 to 2193.17 tokens/query and 0.90 had 21 paired breaks.
research_note: Read-only post-result enumeration found no monotone fixed V8 schedule dominating all six learned quality counts at the learned cost. This is design-side trade-off evidence, not a preregistered GO result.
